about: The display-language rule of the server (Helpers/LanguageTags.cs) and the client (js/enhanced/translations.js, which the server serves with this rule written in): trim the 'space' characters; a 'reserved' word (any case) is no tag; else the 'tag' expression with each variant once, in canonical case (language lower, Script title, REGION upper, variants lower). A tag is accepted when it or its language is a locale bundle this build ships (a file in js/locales, any case; read from the embedded resources at run time); anything else is Auto.
